Items.Name: Gajakesari Yoga
Items.Description: Traditionally formed when Jupiter occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house) from the Moon.
Items.Impact: Traditionally associated with wisdom, reputation, learning and prosperity. Actual results depend on the complete horoscope, planetary dignity, aspects and dasha.

Statements: Gajakesari Yoga can support rise in status when the involved planets are strong.
Leadership, authority, and public respect may improve during supportive dashas.
Results become clearer when effort, timing, and planetary dignity align.
Confidence, judgment, and capacity for responsibility may strengthen.
The native may receive support from mentors, seniors, or fortunate circumstances.
Maturity helps convert this yoga into stable achievement.
Better opportunities can improve financial stability over time.
Social reputation may become a source of support.
Benefits are stronger when the related houses are unafflicted.
